profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lenovo
profile.summary:
Highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer. Dependable,  results-oriented professional with a solid performance track.  Easily adaptable to change, with eagerness toward learning and expanding capabilities. Ability to work autonomously and as a team player with individual responsibilities and deadlines. Hard working, reliable, solutions driven achiever with strong organizational skills. Enthusiastic self-starter and innovative problem solver with excellent analytical, inter-personal, and communication skills.

Specialties: Java, JavaScript, XML, HTML, AJAX, REST, Dojo, C, C++, Assembly, Embedded Firmware Design and Development, Object Oriented Programming and Design, Windows Device Driver Development, Linux Kernel and Device Driver Development, Linux Shell Programming, Perl scripting. Fluent in Spanish.

positions.title: Systems Advisor
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, implemented and maintained the IBM Flex Systems Manager (FSM) web solution to manage and control Chassis Management Modules including physical and virtual compute, storage and networking resources using Java, Javascript, Dojo, JSF, JSP, XML, J2EE, REST, HTML, CSS, Ajax, Eclipse IDE, Linux, Rational (ClearCase, Clearquest) code management tools, Agile programming.
- Firmware development and configuration for BIOS, BMC, RSA, FPGA components on Intel and AMD processors based servers and blades using C/C++ and Assembly on Windows Server, Linux, Solaris and FreeBSD environments.
- Installation and support of Linux, Windows Server, Solaris, VMWare and FreeBSD systems.
- Firmware development of power control systems on PowerPC embedded microcontrollers using C/C++ and Assembly on Linux and AIX platforms.
- Maintenance and support of legacy power control firmware.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed, implemented and maintained firmware for embedded 8-bit and 16-bit microcontrollers in temperature and power controllers using C and Assembly programming in CodeWarrior and MPLAB Development Environments for Microsoft Windows Operating Systems, Motorola/Freescale 8-bit microcontrollers, Microchip 16-bit microcontrollers, Microsoft Visual SourceSafe, DOORS, Microsoft Office Suite tools.

positions.title: Principal Consultant
positions.description:
- Firmware development of power control systems on PowerPC embedded microcontrollers using C/C++ and Assembly on Linux and AIX platforms.
- Maintenance and support of legacy power control firmware.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- SCSI Device Drivers and Data Distribution Architecture development for Retail Solutions Operating System using C and Assembly.
- Software Development Kit and Disk APIs development for IBM servers using C.
- PC Software preloads development using C++, MFC, JavaScript, ActiveX, Java and InstallShield on a Windows development environment.
- AS/400 Client Access component and GUI development using C/C++, Java, Assembly on Windows and AS/400 environments.

honors.title: Outstanding Performance Award
honors.description: Achieved the “Outstanding Performance Award” for outstanding contributions.

projects.title: IBM ToolsCenter - IBM Advanced Settings Utility (ASU) & Firmware Updates
projects.description:
I reated C++ based command line tools for the configuration and updating of IBM and OEM based Blade Systems. These applications targeted a variety of Microsoft Windows based and Linux based operating systems, pre-boot environments and virtualized images (ESXi,VMWare).
Implemented solutions using Intel KCS and LAN IPMI, CIM, XML, SLP, TFTP, FTP, SSH, WMI, WBEM, and other TCP/IP based protocols.

projects.title: Service Processor Software Lead
projects.description:
Designed, implemented and supported service processor designs based on embedded Linux.
Lead a team of three to five developers in creating solutions and implementing interface requirements.
Lead the conversion of a software project from an embedded Intel firmware product to a C++ application running on PowerPC Linux.
Investigated and resolved manufacturing and field defects related to power subsystems (fans, power supplies, voltage regulators, etc.).
